parsed.explanation: The dossier documents a criminalising, authoritarian state: Article 310(1) carries up to seven years, was applied to foreign nationals (expulsions in 2004 and 2013), and detention for suspected same-sex conduct occurs within a prison system where torture and beating are commonplace — a tier-2/state-imposed exposure with no working remedy. The state frames LGBTQ status as an epithet for disloyalty, bans public LGBTQ expression and organisations, offers conversion therapy in lieu of jail, and rejects reform outright. Trans-specific reach of the law is unresolved, so extrapolation follows rule 13: criminalisation, absent recognition, no record of relief. Stale enforcement records (2003/2013) neither prove continuation nor safety; the 2026 overview confirms the statute in force. No documented trans-specific violence rate, but detention conditions and state hostility dominate.
